subject: Post-call: PoC trial environment options and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@acmeai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: PoC trial environment options and next steps

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap plus proposed next steps so we can get your PoC started smoothly.

Call recap (high level)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Acme AI's document summarization pipeline (latency, cost, and accuracy on 10K docs).
- Success criteria you called out:
  1) 99% of generated summaries meet the QA accuracy threshold (F1 >= 0.78) on the provided eval set;
  2) 95th percentile latency < 600ms for typical 512-token prompts;
  3) Throughput >= 30 reqs/sec sustained for 10-minute windows;
  4) Clear cost projection within target $X/token (we'll model this).

Environment options we discussed
- Hosted trial (fastest): Redwood-managed, hosted API with trial credits. Good for functional validation and latency/cost profiling.
- Dedicated sandbox: Reserved pool for Acme with isolated GPUs and consistent throughput—better for throughput/scale tests.
- VPC trial (hosted-VPC): Customer network peering or VPC delivery for sensitive data, encryption + audit logs. Takes longer to provision.

Immediate asks / decision needed
1) Which environment do you want to start with for week 1? (Hosted recommended to unblock quickly; we can pivot to Dedicated or VPC for scale/security tests)
2) Provide 1-2 members who will own data uploads and evaluation (name + email).
3) Sample eval dataset (S3 link or shared Drive) and a small set of representative prompts.

Proposed plan / timeline (flexible)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize environment choice and sign trial acknowledgment.
- Week 1 (provisioning): Redwood provisions Hosted trial or Reserved sandbox (2-3 business days for Hosted; 5-7 for Dedicated; 10+ for VPC).
- Week 2 (validation): Run eval suite, tune batching/quantization, measure latency and throughput.
- Week 3 (wrap): Review results, cost model, and next steps (pilot/contract).

Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa (PM) — trial coordination, onboarding docs, eval harness; Aditya (SRE) — infra provisioning and capacity; Marcus (Solutions) — integration support and prompt engineering.
- Acme: please confirm owners for integration and security review.

Attachments: trial-checklist.pdf (checklist + required info), onboarding-runbook.md (provision steps).

Next steps
- Please reply with environment choice and owners by EOD Tue (May 31).
- If Hosted, we can provision access by Thu (Jun 3). If Dedicated, earliest Jun 7. If VPC, earliest Jun 14 (depends on network).

Proposed times for a 30-min kickoff: Tue 5/31 10-10:30am PT or Wed 6/1 9-9:30am PT — I can send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions PM, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Lee <bob@acmeai.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: PoC trial environment options and next steps

Thanks Marissa — great summary.

We want to move quickly and start with the Hosted trial so our ML team can validate accuracy and latency this week. After functional validation we expect to run a production-like scale test; for that test we'll likely need a Dedicated sandbox or a Hosted-VPC depending on how the security review goes.

Owners:
- Integration lead: Bob Lee <bob@acmeai.com> (owns dataset preparation / API integration)
- Security lead: Carol Park <carol@acmeai.com> (will manage questionnaire + legal)

We'll upload a 2k-doc eval set to S3 and share the link by EOD Tue. Also attaching our partially filled security questionnaire (acme-security-questionnaire-filled.pdf) — Carol will finish the rest.

On the success criteria: the accuracy target looks right. For throughput, we may start with 20 reqs/sec then scale to 30. Please confirm that Hosted provides stable latency at our target 512-token scenario.

Hosted kickoff time: Tue 5/31 10am PT works for Bob and me.

Best,
Alice
VP Product, Acme AI

On Sun, May 30, 2027 at 1:05 PM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> (See above)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Bob Lee <bob@acmeai.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice@acmeai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: PoC trial environment options and next steps

Perfect — thanks for confirming Alice. Hosting plan below with concrete tasks and timeline.

Evaluation plan ( Hosted trial, 2-week focused run )
- Day 0 (provisioning): Redwood creates trial API keys, sample prompts, and an eval harness (pytest-based) that runs your 2k-doc set.
- Day 1-3 (functional validation): Run eval harness, iterate on prompts; record model version, token counts, and baseline latency.
- Day 4-7 (load tests): Run controlled throughput tests up to 20 reqs/sec then ramp to 30 reqs/sec; we will capture p50/p95/p99 latency and GPU utilization.
- Day 8-12 (cost & tuning): Apply batching and caching suggestions to hit cost targets; measure quality delta.
- Day 13-14 (wrap): Review and prepare recommendation (next: Dedicated or VPC for scale/security).

Provisioning checklist (what we need from Acme to start Hosted trial)
- Shared S3 link to eval set (or Drive link) — please include read-only creds.
- Example prompts & expected outputs (2-5 examples).
- Confirmation of API usage constraints (any rate limits we should enforce for the trial).

Redwood responsibilities and timelines
- Marissa: Coordinate kickoff, share onboarding docs, schedule wrap review (owner).
- Aditya: Provision trial access and run initial smoke tests (ETA Thu Jun 3).
- Marcus: Integration support and prompt tuning; available during Day 1-7 windows.

If you confirm Hosted, I'll send the invite for Tue 5/31 10:00am PT and kick off provisioning. I also attached the onboarding-runbook.md with detailed steps.

Next steps
1) Alice/Bob: share S3 link + confirm 10am PT kickoff.
2) Redwood: we provision keys and run smoke test by Thu Jun 3.

Thanks — excited to get started.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions PM, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: PoC trial environment options and next steps (SRE tasks)

Marissa / Marcus — quick internal note on infra tasks and ETA.

Action items for SRE (Aditya owner):
- Provision Hosted trial creds & API key for acmeai@test-redwood (create read-only API key tied to trial credits).
- Run smoke tests on 512-token prompts and share p50/p95 results.
- Prepare Dedicated sandbox estimate (GPU type, vCPUs, expected throughput) and cost delta if they ask to scale after Week 1 (ETA for estimate: Fri Jun 4).
- Start VPC prep checklist (network peering, routing, IP allowlist template) so we can give Acme a clear timeline if they request VPC (ETA initial checklist: Jun 4).

I'll provision the Hosted creds today and post results in the kickoff thread. If Marcus can be on the Tue 10am PT kickoff that helps for prompt tuning.

Thanks,
Aditya
